questions.question: Explain the importance of etiquettes in dealing with hotel guests.
questions.solution_html:
• Explain the importance of etiquettes in dealing with hotel guests. / [CO1]
  • Etiquettes are the polite manners and professional behavior followed while interacting with guests in a
  • hotel.
  • Importance of etiquettes:
  • • Creates a positive first impression
  • • Builds guest confidence and satisfaction
  • • Improves communication between staff and guests
  • • Helps maintain professionalism in hotel operations
  • • Encourages repeat visits and customer loyalty
  • • Enhances the reputation and image of the hotel
  • • Reduces misunderstandings and complaints
  • Conclusion:
  • Good etiquettes are essential in hospitality because they ensure respectful and pleasant guest
  • experiences.

questions.question: Describe the role of front office cashier in hotel operations.
questions.solution_html:
• Describe the role of front office cashier in hotel operations. / [CO1]
  • The front office cashier handles guest accounts and financial transactions in the hotel.
  • Roles and responsibilities:
  • • Preparing guest bills and invoices
  • • Collecting payments through cash, card, or online methods
  • • Maintaining guest account records
  • • Handling currency exchange where applicable
  • • Posting charges for room service, food, and other services
  • • Verifying billing accuracy during check-out
  • • Coordinating with other departments regarding guest charges
  • Importance:
  • The front office cashier ensures smooth financial operations and accurate settlement of guest
  • accounts.

questions.question: Discuss the objectives of reservation system in a hotel.
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss the objectives of reservation system in a hotel. / [CO2]
  • A reservation system is used to manage room bookings efficiently in hotels.
  • Objectives of reservation system:
  • • To ensure advance booking of rooms
  • • To maintain proper room occupancy levels
  • • To avoid overbooking and underbooking
  • • To provide accurate room availability information
  • • To improve guest convenience and satisfaction
  • • To help in forecasting room sales and revenue
  • • To maintain proper guest reservation records
  • Conclusion:
  • An effective reservation system improves operational efficiency and increases hotel revenue.

questions.question: Evaluate the role of proper emergency handling in protecting hotel image.
questions.solution_html:
• Evaluate the role of proper emergency handling in protecting hotel image. / [CO5]
  • Emergency handling refers to the actions taken during situations such as fire, accidents, medical
  • emergencies, or security threats.
  • Role in protecting hotel image:
  • • Ensures safety of guests and staff
  • • Reduces panic and confusion during emergencies
  • • Shows professionalism and preparedness of the hotel
  • • Builds guest trust and confidence
  • • Prevents negative publicity and reputation damage
  • • Helps hotels comply with safety regulations
  • • Improves customer satisfaction even during difficult situations
  • Conclusion:
  • Proper emergency handling is important for maintaining the safety, reputation, and credibility of a hotel.

questions.question: Describe the principles of handling guest complaints in a hotel.
questions.solution_html:
• Describe the principles of handling guest complaints in a hotel. / [CO5]
  • Guest complaints should be handled carefully and professionally to maintain guest satisfaction.
  • Principles of complaint handling:
  • • Listen carefully to the guest
  • • Remain calm and polite
  • • Show empathy and understanding
  • • Avoid arguments with guests
  • • Apologize sincerely for inconvenience
  • • Find quick and suitable solutions
  • • Follow up to ensure guest satisfaction
  • • Record complaints for future improvement
  • Conclusion:
  • Effective complaint handling helps improve guest relations and strengthens the hotel’s reputation.

questions.question: Analyse the role of reservation system in controlling room inventory.
questions.solution_html:
• Analyse the role of reservation system in controlling room inventory. / [CO2]
  • Room inventory refers to the total number of rooms available for sale in a hotel.
  • Role of reservation system:
  • • Provides real-time room availability information
  • • Prevents overbooking and double booking
  • • Helps allocate rooms efficiently
  • • Tracks occupied, vacant, and reserved rooms
  • • Assists management in forecasting demand
  • • Supports better pricing and revenue management
  • • Improves coordination between departments
  • Conclusion:
  • A reservation system plays a vital role in managing room inventory efficiently and maximizing hotel
  • occupancy.
